facts.label: Note
facts.value: Swinhoe S241 p.333: 'the village of Tsing-lung-cheaow, so called from the short stone bridge it leads out on'. 日下 j100:5b the 青龙桥 sluice and a 城关 half a li east. Also: Tour du monde 1864 sketch read at px 630,380, fit rms 427 m (schematic) (Village), 68 m from the point used.
